'''Iridium''' was an element that could be mined. [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] was said to have significant deposits of iridium.<ref name="DF:JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> High levels of iridium were also found on the water world [[Stroiketcy]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> The [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] was thick with both iridium and [[heglum]] that had to be scrubbed from the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] passing through its clouds.<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>

Approximately [[8000 BBY|8,000 years]] before the Galactic Civil War, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] traders discovered pure iridium ore on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. They traded the ore for flashy technological bagatelles with the primitive [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]].<ref name="Goroth: Slave of the Empire">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
